hooks.name: TypeScript Type Check
hooks.description: After saving a .ts or .tsx file, runs tsc --noEmit and reports either "✓ no type errors" if the exit code is 0, or the count and locations of type errors found if the exit code is non-zero. Satisfies R14.3 (build must exit 0 with zero TypeScript errors before commit).

action.command: tsc --noEmit 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Output "✓ no type errors" } else { $errors = tsc --noEmit 2>&1; $count = ($errors | Select-String "error TS").Count; Write-Output "✗ $count type error(s) found:"; $errors | Select-String "error TS" | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_.Line } }
